title: Run and expose the complete reusable flywheel in the arXiv reviewer
description:
## Milestone
A human can rate real arXiv items and observe the reusable library improving its classifier. Three independent adjustable request parts: state.rubric, fixed labeled examples, and decision-element classification questions/options. Main and element answers become features for a trained ML head. One decision-model request per item when supported, containing the complete state and questions. Retrieval and input-filter optimization are deferred.

## End-to-end acceptance
Given eligible labels and explanations and an incumbent classifier
When a feedback round runs
Then the optimizer proposes a traceable change, code validates it, the decision model produces all required candidate features, the head is fitted on trusted training labels, the candidate is compared on development data, and a version is promoted or rejected
And the reviewer exposes prompts, replies/tool calls, changes, fitting and measured results
And a restart preserves the active version, labels and event history.

Completion requires a fake-client cross-module test plus an explicitly authorized bounded live demonstration; passing component tests alone is insufficient. Native provider-neutral library only; no DSPy. The application does not implement a second flywheel. Optimizer proposes; code validates/applies; numerical fitting alone sets weights and calibration. Training, development, random audit and sealed scoreboard remain separated. No credentials or private article text in committed artifacts. Specs first with fake clients; live calls explicit and budgeted.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Requirement-by-requirement technology audit complete. All child stories are closed, including independent staged feature trials, retained revisions/combinations, and reviewer lifecycle. Current reviewer_flywheel specs cover trusted explanations/metadata, protected-comment firewall, independent cadence and restart. Cross-module complete_feedback_loop and shared_provider_lifecycle specs prove proposal->validated full requests->probability features->OOF fit->development promotion/rejection->served head->restart/correction, with Jev/Kev/Laya injected transports. Existing explicitly approved private live artifact var/arxiv-replay-v2/runtime.sqlite3 has one actual gpt-6-luna request/reply (23764 returned tokens),79 decision request/reply pairs,65-row OOF fit, development evaluation and rejection, plus26 predictions. That historical four-development-label trial demonstrates execution only, not classifier quality; current default coverage floors remain intact. UI transcript/activity and exact decision exchanges were separately browser verified. No new paid demonstration or experiment report is required or claimed. Remaining tablet/dark app acceptance is owned by the scorecard SPA issues.
